failedAssertions.reason: migrate down now leaves zero tables, but the run still exits non-zero because the migrate tool errors after the down migration drops schema_migrations (relation "public.schema_migrations" does not exist).

successful auth.signup and auth.signin.password operations still serialize result:{} instead of result.user, so /api/v1/auth/session/exchange returns 400 "operation has no user result" and authenticated follow-up checks remain inaccessible.

appliedUpdates.description: Documented that backend-hardening API reruns should rebuild janus-api with podman compose up -d --build to avoid stale container binaries before validating live error envelopes.
